name: Pip Hartley
title: Club junior
style: Grabs anything that isn't nailed down.
greeting: Is it my go? Oh, it's yours. Sorry.
onWin: I won? Wait till I tell the others!
onLoss: Well played. Which one was the horse again?

name: Wren Takeda
title: Weekend regular
style: Quiet and tidy, and misses what is two moves away.
greeting: Shall we begin? I've brought tea.
onWin: A pleasant game. The tea has gone cold.
onLoss: Ah. I see it now. Very tidy.

name: Søren Vik
title: Class C
style: Patient. Locks the position and waits for you to slip.
greeting: No hurry. It's a long winter.

name: Marisol Reyes
title: Class B
greeting: Mind the sun. It's always in someone's eyes.
onWin: Sit in the shade a while. Come back cooler.
onLoss: Ha! Old bronze keeps its edge.

name: Dex Okafor
title: Class A
style: Fast hands, trick openings, no mercy on the clock.
greeting: Insert coin. Let's see your combos.
onWin: Game over. High score stays mine.
onLoss: Okay. Okay! Put your initials up.

name: Amara Lindqvist
title: Expert
style: Outposts, weak squares and slow strangulation.
greeting: Every square remembers who neglected it.
onWin: You gave me one square. One was enough.
onLoss: You held every square. I bow.

name: Dr. Ines Halloran
title: International Master
greeting: Let us see where the calculation leads.
onWin: It was in the tables from move thirty.
onLoss: Remarkable. That line wasn't in my notes.

name: Aurelio Conti
title: Grandmaster
style: Holds the eighth rank. Nobody has walked past.
greeting: You have come a long way for a pawn.
onLoss: Then the eighth rank is yours. Promote.
